nodes.name: Lead Event Webhook
nodes.notes: Use the Production URL in N8N_LEAD_WEBHOOK_URL after publishing the workflow.

nodes.name: Validate Secret
nodes.notes: Paste the same secret string here that the app uses in N8N_WEBHOOK_SECRET. This workflow avoids $env because local n8n can deny env access.

nodes.name: Prepare CRM Row
nodes.notes: Normalizes webhook body into flat fields so Sheets and Telegram nodes never depend on nested payload paths.

nodes.name: Duplicate Guard
nodes.notes: Local/demo duplicate protection. For real deployment, replace with CRM/Data Store lookup by eventId.

nodes.name: Skip Duplicate
nodes.notes: Duplicate event was accepted but not written or notified.

nodes.name: Append Google Sheets Row
nodes.notes: Fill Document and Sheet credentials after import. Keep retry enabled for Google API timeouts.

nodes.name: Notify Intake
nodes.notes: Paste the admin/private/group chat ID here. Optional: remove this node if intake alerts are too noisy.
